description: The quiet garden, a walled sculpture garden north of the quad: its old stone fountain, the flowers in bloom this month, the birds passing over now, and five public-domain sculptures. Name a "sculpture" to stand in front of it (show_image: true adds its photograph), or a "flower" to smell it. Nothing is stored.

flower.description: Optional: a flower to smell, such as "rose" or "lavender".

sculpture.description: Optional: a sculpture's slug or title, such as "crane" or "heqat".

show_image.description: With "sculpture": true to include its photograph (a JPEG about 600 pixels tall).

name: walk_in_the_garden
title: Walk in the quiet garden
